entries.en: The Red's recent activities give me cause for concern, . They have begun moving their imperial weaponry out of storage. There can be no doubt─they are planning an assault, and we may well be the targets.
entries.macro: The Red's recent activities give me cause for concern, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>. They have begun moving their imperial weaponry out of storage. There can be no doubt─they are planning an assault, and we may well be the targets.
entries.fr: Les Rouges sont en train de préparer un mauvais couuuup ! Ils ont récupéré des armes impériales sur l'île de Zekki et attendent le moment idéal pour lancer un assaut meurtrieeeer !
entries.ja:
、紅甲羅の動きが怪しいんだぁ～。
ゼッキ島の奥にしまいこんでた、帝国の武器を出してきて、
今にも、どこかを襲いそうな気配がすんだよぉ～。

entries.en: To see that this does not come to pass, I have a mind to sabotage these weapons. We have some Confederate explosives that would be suitable for this purpose, but they are not made for large Kojin hands.
entries.fr: Ils vont tenter de conquérir Tamamizu, j'en mets ma main à coupeeeer ! Nous devons détruire leur armement avant qu'il ne soit trop tard, mais tu sais aussi bien que moi que les Kojin et les explosifs, ça fait deuuuux !
entries.ja:
もしかしたら、ここが標的になるかもしれねぇ～！
そうなる前に武器を壊してぇが、
俺たちの手じゃ、爆弾をうまく扱えねぇんだぁ～。

entries.en: And so we must turn to you. I ask that you infiltrate the Red stronghold, the Isle of Zekki, and use the explosives to destroy the imperial crates that you see lying about. May the kami bless you and keep you!

entries.en: , I've awaited your return with bated breath! Tell me you were able to destroy the weapons!

entries.fr: Ah, c'est toiiii ! Sommes-nous hors de dangeeeer ?

entries.en: Oh, the relief! Thanks to you, we may rest easy for a while. But that is not to say we can afford to slacken our vigil.
entries.fr: Ouf, me voilà grandement rassuréééé ! Heureusement que tu étais là, comme toujouuuurs !
entries.ja:
うまくいったんだなぁ～、ありがてぇ～！
これで、しばらくは安心できそうだぜぇ～。

entries.en: Even assuming the Red are defanged for now, they can easily acquire more weapons from their imperial masters. We may well have need of your prowess again.
entries.fr: Malheureusement, tout le monde sait que les Rouges ont longtemps collaboré avec l'Empiiiire... Si jamais ils tentent de remettre ça un de ces jours avec d'autres armes dont nous ne soupçonnions pas l'existence, je te le ferai savoiiiir.
entries.ja:
けれど、あいつらは長いこと、帝国と取引してたからなぁ～、
まだ武器を溜めこんでるかもしれねぇんだぁ～。
今度また頼むかもしれないが、よろしくお願いするぜぇ～。
